flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Notice/form/NoticeOccurences.tsx (grid warrant_no, offender_id, detail date_of_visit/visit_flag, filter vehicle_no/summon_no; tab commented out in Form.tsx and GroupPreview.tsx), utils/config/env.ts, utils/models/Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts. No WA record detail page, no work order number, address visited, or added/updated date fields for WA; the offencenoticeoccurrences and warrantofarrest controllers are not in the repos
note: The story status is blank in stories.json (requirement not given), so it is traced normally. This 1-point story asks to view the full details of a searched WA record (work order number, warrant type, name, vehicle number, address visited, dates added/updated). There is no WA record detail page. The closest is the Notice Occurrences component (NoticeOccurences.tsx) with warrant_no and offender_id columns, vehicle_no/summon_no/warrant_no filters, and a detail panel with warrant_no, date_of_visit, date_of_arrest, visit_flag, remarks (:203-246). But its tab is commented out in Form.tsx:219-226 and GroupPreview.tsx:127-132 so officers do not see it, its data source only exists when isAPIFound (STAGING/LOCAL, env.ts:11; :69), and the offencenoticeoccurrences controller is not in the repos (cannot verify from repo). Work order number and address visited are in no repo; warrant_type exists only in the type Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts and a validation message, and is not displayed. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done: there is no WA record detail page. Only the Notice Occurrences component is similar and its tab is commented out. Depends on OCMS34.1/34.2

steps.step: After searching, the officer opens the full details of one WA record
steps.detail: There is no WA record detail route/page. Notice Search only leads to the notice detail. The Notice Occurrences component has a row onClick (NoticeOccurences.tsx:75) to select one row and a detail panel, but that is a notice occurrence, not a WA record, its tab is commented out (Form.tsx:219-226; GroupPreview.tsx:127-132), and its data source is only active on STAGING/LOCAL (env.ts:11).

steps.step: The details show the work order number and warrant type
steps.detail: Work order number is in no repo (grep workorder / work_order only finds the commented-out report tab). warrant_type exists only in the type Iwarrantofarrest (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:1-40) and an i18n validation message; no component displays it.

steps.step: The details show name, vehicle number and warrant number
steps.detail: The Notice Occurrences component shows warrant_no (NoticeOccurences.tsx:90; detail panel :203-206) and offender_id (:77-82), with vehicle_no and warrant_no filters (:140-147). That is occurrence data of one notice, not a WA record; there is no name or vehicle_no column in the grid or detail fields. Its tab is commented out (Form.tsx:219-226; GroupPreview.tsx:127-132), the data source exists only on STAGING/LOCAL (:69; env.ts:11), and the offencenoticeoccurrences backend is not in the repos (cannot verify from repo). Because the component exists but is not mounted, it is rated Sebagian.

steps.step: The details show address visited and the dates added and updated
steps.detail: Address visited is in no repo; date_of_visit and date_of_arrest exist in the unmounted Occurrences detail panel (NoticeOccurences.tsx:229-238) but they are not added/updated dates. The type Iwarrantofarrest has cre_date and upd_date (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:12-14) but only as a type declaration, with no display or backend.
